# FliskOS

> A free, local desktop app that puts every Flisk project and the coding agents working on them in one window.

FliskOS runs on macOS and Windows. It starts, stops and restarts projects, shows a doctor score for each one, and gives you one place to talk to the agents on a thread. It never asks for an API key: each agent runs in the project folder on your own login.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://os.flisk.si/): product overview and screenshots
- [Download for macOS](https://os.flisk.si/download/mac): latest release zip
- [Download for Windows](https://os.flisk.si/download/windows): latest release zip
- [Install script](https://os.flisk.si/install.sh): the script run once after installing the app
- [Live demo](https://os.flisk.si/demo/): the real app running on sample projects, no sign-in
